query: The Far Bed Answers The far bed answers back today: every vine in it turns to follow you. On the way out you find a seed in your coat pocket that wasn't there this morning, and it has already put out a shoot. Keep it and grow it You cup it in your palm. The shoot curls round your finger, firmly. Tobias, when you show him, goes pale and then delighted. "That's a hedge-seed," he says. "They choose people." Give it to Tobias Tobias takes it gently and puts it in a pot by the door. "It'll want you back," he says. "They usually do."
